My Why

Hi, I'm Lo Limone! I'm the person who stops to say hi to every dog on the sidewalk, and these days I get to turn that love into one-of-a-kind oil pastel portraits.

If you're anything like me, your camera roll is overflowing with pet pics. I love pulling one of those buried favorites out of the scroll and giving it a spot on your wall. The crooked ears, the dreamy stares, the way they sit like a tiny person: capturing those little bits of personality is my favorite part.

Fair warning, my style is a little unpredictable (that's half the fun). I let my hands lead, color outside the lines on purpose, and add a little extra magic whenever a piece asks for it. I also truly love drawing a wonky photo, so don't hold back on that filtered pet selfie! (Peep Uncle Nick in the gallery.)

Whether they're curled up beside you right now or watching over you from somewhere sunnier, thank you for sharing them with me. It means the world to help you keep them close, in a portrait made to be treasured or gifted.

~LoLL
